site.name: Playersoft Technologies
site.description: Award-winning mobile solutions that simplify casino operations and elevate the player experience.

_notes.policyLinks: Terms / Privacy / Accessibility point at pages that do not exist yet. Create them or update these URLs before launch.
_notes.partners: A Partners page exists on the current live site but was intentionally removed from this redesign. Do not re-add the nav link without asking.
_notes.basePath: GitHub Pages: leave "" for a custom domain (playersoft.com) or a user/org site (playersoft.github.io). Set to "/repo-name" for a project site served at username.github.io/repo-name/. Rebuild after changing — it rewrites every asset path, link, canonical tag, and sitemap URL.
_notes.forms: GitHub Pages serves static files only — it cannot process form submissions. The contact and newsletter forms need a third-party endpoint (Formspree, Basin, Getform) or they will do nothing. See README.md step 4.
_notes.newsletter: The newsletter / "The Play" email signup was removed from this redesign at the client's request, along with the News page. Nothing on the site collects email addresses now except the contact form.
